project_info.theme: Laneige Neo Cushion exclusive Shopee debut
project_info.color_palette: Soft gray-lavender, chrome silver, white, orange-red, black

main_subject.detail: A premium minimalist poster featuring Laneige and Shopee Debut. Top-right badge reads 'CON 1 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'. The core copy says 'RA MAT DOC QUYEN PHIEN BAN MOI NEO CUSHION TAI DINH NGHIA LOP NEN HOAN HAO'. A male celebrity in a black leather jacket leans on a dark tabletop, resting his face on one hand and touching two compact cases, one silver and one pastel pink. Chrome star-shaped decorative elements float around the scene. Bottom CTA says 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'.
main_subject.style: Luxury minimalist beauty campaign with muted editorial backdrop, realistic celebrity portrait, and glossy chrome typography accents

composition_elements.text: LANEIGE / SHOPEE DEBUT / CON 1 NGAY / NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG / RA MAT DOC QUYEN / PHIEN BAN MOI / NEO CUSHION / TAI DINH NGHIA LOP NEN HOAN HAO / MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for Laneige Neo Cushion on Shopee Debut. Centerpiece is a male celebrity in a black leather jacket leaning on a dark table and touching two compact cases, one silver and one pastel pink. Background is a soft gray-lavender studio field with chrome star ornaments. Surrounding elements: Shopee and Laneige logos, Shopee Debut badge, countdown 'CON 1 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG', headline 'RA MAT DOC QUYEN PHIEN BAN MOI NEO CUSHION TAI DINH NGHIA LOP NEN HOAN HAO', and orange CTA 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'. Technical style: premium beauty key visual with photo-composite portrait and product props, soft luxury studio lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
